test.create_query: CREATE TABLE perf_arr_fs( arr Array(FixedString(8)), arr_str Array(String) ) ENGINE = MergeTree() ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO perf_arr_fs SELECT arrayMap(i -> toFixedString(concat('v', toString((number % 97) + i)), 8), range(20)), arrayMap(i -> concat('v', toString((number % 97) + i)), range(20)) FROM numbers(5000000)
